{{Short description|Italian mathematician (1681–1754)}}
[[File:Chelucci - Institutiones arithmeticae cum appendice de natura, atque usu logarithmorum, 1743 - 1287354.jpg|thumb|''Institutiones arithmeticæ'' (1743)]]

'''Domenico Chelucci''' (in [[Religious name|religion]] '''Paolino di S. Giuseppe'''; [[Lucca]], 25 April 1681 – [[Rome]], 17 January 1754) was an Italian [[mathematician]] and [[Priesthood in the Catholic Church|priest]] of the Order of the [[Piarists]], professor and later rector of the Collegio Nazareno ("Nazarene College") in Rome.<ref>{{Dizionario Biografico degli Italiani|url=https://www.treccani.it/enciclopedia/domenico-chelucci_(Dizionario-Biografico)/|author=Ugo Baldini|title=CHELUCCI, Domenico|volume=24}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|language=it|url=https://matematicaitaliana.sns.it/autori/1386/|title=Paolino Chelucci|website=Mathematica Italiana|location=Pisa|publisher=Centro di Ricerca Matematica "Ennio De Giorgi"|access-date=2025-04-17}}</ref>
